RV64 virt QEMU 11.1.3, one hart, release FP-RISC e138e654332f, QOS 0e2cdb9 plus block-timeline and trial probes.
Instrumented: python3 tools/block-trial.py <empty-output-dir>. Timing-only: add --timing-only. Set FPRISC_ROOT to the release checkout.
Three shuffled fresh-disk boots per arm, 16 replays per boot, including first replay. Stable-size streams with unique ordered eight-byte events. All replies verified.
Input is the native FS.replay RPC from a kernel test client. QOS runs a concurrent 1 ms heartbeat actor. CPU percent covers the whole QEMU boot, including initialization and UART.
Percentiles use nearest rank across 48 replay calls; independent boot count is three. No hardware, multiclient load or physical storage latency claim.
All phase columns are cumulative per replay. Owner dequeue timestamp is at the successful receive branch before retaining the tuple.
Reuse holds one record payload within a single replay; profile counts are actual 4 KiB reads and distinct page numbers. Samples use guest ticks of 100 ns.
